description: The Truth About Politics in Missouri: Why is it so hard to get conservative legislation passed﻿ with Republican supermajorities in the House and Senate? Too many elected Republicans do not understand the system of government our Founders gave us; or worse enrich themselves while selling out your rights to special interests and lobbyists. They then have the audacity to pretend to be conservatives to their constituents. Our liberties are under attack and I won't stand for it!
